about.heading: Who I am
paragraphs: Computer Science student at EPITECH Paris (Bachelor 02 / B02). After completing the EPITECH Java Piscine in September 2026, I focused my learning path on cybersecurity.

I build concrete projects such as Secure Vault (a secure Java CLI file vault), a Home SOC Lab (traffic analysis, SSH log monitoring, and detection), and CTF challenges in Exegol, alongside core networking foundations.
I learn by building, testing, and analyzing real system behavior and protocol mechanics.

hero.title: About
hero.bio: Computer Science Student (B02) at EPITECH Paris. Focus on cybersecurity, Java, Linux, networking, and security labs.

blocks.title: From Lycée Amara Rachid to EPITECH Paris
blocks.body:
I graduated with a Mathematics Baccalaureate (High Honors, 16.28/20) at Lycée Amara Rachid in Algiers. Alongside high school, I completed a 192-hour web development training program at Code213.

In 2025, I joined computer science studies before continuing at EPITECH Paris (Bachelor 02 / B02). Completing the EPITECH Java Piscine in September 2026 was a major milestone toward building independent cybersecurity projects.

blocks.title: Why Cybersecurity
blocks.body:
What drives me is understanding how systems and networks work beneath the surface. Analyzing how data packets travel, how authentication and encryption protect files, and how to detect anomalies on a Linux server.

My focus areas include offensive security foundations (Nmap enumeration, Exegol CTFs, vulnerability analysis), defensive security (Wireshark/tcpdump packet analysis, SSH log monitoring, detection), network infrastructure (GNS3, ESXi, pfSense), and secure Java development.

blocks.title: Methodology & Teamwork
blocks.body:
I learn by building, testing, and documenting. When something breaks, I investigate the root cause rather than applying quick workarounds.

In team settings, I bring technical rigor and clarity. During the Rube Goldberg Machine competition, I managed the 3D design on Tinkercad, winning 1st place locally and advancing to the national presentation.

items.title: Technical rigor
items.body: Designed a secure corporate network infrastructure: HLD/LLD docs, VLAN segmentation, Linux deployment in a virtual environment. The architecture held up under tests.
